name: APIVerveWebsitetoText
summary: Website to Text converts any webpage URL into plain text stripped of HTML tags.
description:
Website to Text converts any webpage URL into plain text stripped of HTML tags. It returns the extracted body copy, page title, meta description, publication date, and detected language code.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Website to Text from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
